card.text: Explore Bergelmir, a moon of Saturn, through its lightcurve-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Cassini measured an 8.13-hour rotation period and modest brightness variations for Bergelmir. This ellipsoid uses the inferred minimum elongation with assumed polar depth and orientation. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate ellipsoid adopting minimum equatorial ratio 1.13:1 under uniform reflectivity. Equal short axes and volume scaling are assumed. Orientation and phase are illustrative. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
